findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "book-discovery-call" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Run "Book a discovery call" — an action of this application. It runs immediately when you call it; there is no separate confirmation step, so only call it once …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public-post, public-posts · Public sink: public-post · Destructive: book-discovery-call, public-post, public-posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: public-post, public-posts · Public sink: public-post · Destructive: book-discovery-call, public-post, public-posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
